batch: Classify complete researcher-supplied scholarship PDFs after visual and extracted-text inspection
policy: These are document-scope judgments only. They do not endorse readings, make identity decisions, approve text or image reuse, or imply that object-level extraction is complete.

entries.basis: Complete researcher-supplied article, JSAI 26 (2002), printed pp. 237–272, archive SHA-256 86cbcd17fecce.... Ford assesses Segal's Mandaic section and supplies philological comments, corrected readings and revised translations across numerous catalogued bowls. It is a critical linguistic study rather than a standalone collection catalogue or a complete replacement edition.

Complete researcher-supplied three-page article, BASOR 285 (1992), printed pp. 79–81, archive SHA-256 1e5a426aa7bf.... Cook publishes Oriental Institute bowl A17877 with photograph, physical description, Jewish Babylonian Aramaic text, translation and line commentary.

Complete researcher-supplied chapter, Finds Gone Astray (2018), printed pp. 75–111, archive SHA-256 123bcea3b022.... The chapter separately publishes six Syriac and two Mandaic confiscated bowls with photographs, transcriptions, translations and commentary, and inventories four additional pseudo-script bowls.
